verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents an unauthenticated JSON data API with curl examples and an example response schema. The evidence states that no formal API-description artifact (OpenAPI or equivalent) exists, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The JSON data API is adjacent to this story but is not a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
